description: Connects a precursor microRNA gene to a mature microRNA processed from it. The relationship is many-to-many: a precursor typically yields up to two mature strands, and some mature microRNAs arise from more than one precursor gene.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Sources contributing this relationship; includes miRBase.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time the relationship or its properties were last created or changed.

source_contributions.scope: Human mature microRNAs represented in the miRDB prediction set, with precursor genes present in SPOKE. Relationships may include precursor Gene nodes marked obsolete.
source_contributions.description: The miRBase precursor catalog identifies mature products of precursor microRNA genes. Each distinct precursor gene–mature microRNA pair is represented once.
